Synthetic 18650 9999mAh (Test)

Official specifications:
  • Nominal Capacity: 9999mAh
  • Nominal voltage: 3.60V
  • Max. continuous discharge: 20000mA

A high current test fixture.

At 20A the cell reaches 81°C, but first after discharge has terminated.
At 30A I terminated due to temperature, but the cell do reach 90°C after termination.
The battery is able to deliver 30A, but only for two minutes!
The cell used can be discharged down to 2.5 volt, in my test I only discharges to 2.8 volt.

Conclusion
